title: 第一卷 第3章 师妹你要对我如何第一卷 第4章 你还要在他身上趴到什么时候
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
;;
舒晩昭腰间被一只大手死死扣住，被迫趴在男人胸口，狼狈地挣扎。
可是他的手犹如铁钳，无论她如何扭动都没办法撼动半分。
他昏迷了。
而且不科学的在昏迷的前一秒，把她牢牢禁锢在身上。
好像怕她亲完就跑不负责。
他吸了魔气，体内魔气大肆破坏筋脉，意识陷入沉睡，再这样下去别说入魔，就是能活下去都费劲儿。
谢寒声可是这本小说里的关键男主之一，他要是夭折在开局，她还怎么过任务回家？
一想到自己的亲人得知自己死讯肝肠寸断，伤心欲绝，她的脸色一变再变，慌忙抬手拍他的脸。
小手拍得劈啪作响，还很有节奏。
“二师兄，你别吓我啊，快点醒来。”
“你不能死，睁开眼睛看看我好不好？你死了我可怎么办？”
“至少你告诉我怎么吸魔气，大不了我吸回来。”
她一声声叫唤，声音不自觉染上旁人难以理解的心酸，就像是失去了一切，不断努力去挽回。
系统：【本来可能死不了，再打下去可能真死了，更何况你个女配不用关心他死活，有问题我会通知你。】
还不等舒晩昭说话，不远处一道怒呵：
“舒晩昭，你个禽兽，放开二师兄！”
舒晩昭一愣，她泪眼婆娑地抬头，几道身影御剑而来，犹如划破夜幕的流行，充满了希望。
她隐约觉得那几个人有些熟悉，细细一想，不就是原主记忆中何人她一起做任务，最后不欢而散的几个弟子吗？
他们不是宗主的嫡系亲传弟子，而是普通弟子。

他们几个和舒晩昭分道扬镳后，二师兄交代了几句任务，让他们自己做就不见了踪影。
好不容易做完任务，二师兄迟迟没回来。
思及对方可能去找舒晩昭了，他们没有在原地等候，而是回到和舒晩昭分开的位置。
修行人士视力比凡人好，果不其然远远就看见两道纠缠在一起的人。
不是失踪的二师兄和舒晩昭是谁？
可恶，离老远都听见巴掌声了，舒晩昭在做什么？！
他们本来就讨厌舒晩昭，此时此刻，心头的火气嗖地一下就上来了，雄赳赳气昂昂冲过去，一个个非常不好惹，上去就要骂人。
谁知，凑近一看，舒晩昭白净的小脸泪痕斑斑，眼尾泛红，轻咬着微肿的下唇，可怜兮兮的求救，“二师兄被魔气入体了。”
快，救救！
原本骂人的话憋回嘴里，按照辈分，舒晩昭是亲传弟子，他们应该叫一声小师姐。
可他们根本看不上舒晩昭的作风。
从来都是指名道姓的。

;;
Shu Mingzhao's waist was tightly held by a big hand, and he was forced to lie on the man's chest, struggling in embarrassment.
But his hands were like iron pliers, no matter how much she twisted, she couldn't move them even half an inch.
He was unconscious.
And unscientifically, he tightly imprisoned her in his body the second before she passed out.
It seemed like he was afraid that she would be irresponsible by running away after the kiss.
He inhaled the demonic energy, and the demonic energy in his body wreaked havoc on his muscles and veins, causing his consciousness to fall into a deep sleep. If he continued like this, let alone becoming a demon, it would be difficult to survive.
Xie Hansheng is one of the key male protagonists in this novel. If he died at the beginning, how would she survive the mission and return home?
When she thought of her relatives being heartbroken and heartbroken when they learned of her death, her expression changed again and again, and she hurriedly raised her hand to pat his face.
The little hands clap loudly and rhythmically.
"Second Senior Brother, don't scare me, wake up quickly."
"You can't die, please open your eyes and look at me, okay? What will I do if you die?"
"At least you tell me how to absorb the demonic energy. At worst, I'll absorb it back."
She screamed one after another, and her voice was unconsciously tinged with sadness that was difficult for others to understand, as if she had lost everything and was constantly trying to regain it.
System: [I might not be able to die, but if I keep fighting, I might really die. Besides, you, a female supporting character, don’t have to care about his life or death. If there is any problem, I will inform you. 】
Before Shu Mingzhao could speak, a voice shouted angrily not far away:
"Shu Mizhao, you beast, let go of Second Senior Brother!"
Shu Minzhao was stunned, and she looked up with tears in her eyes. Several figures came with swords, like the waves cutting through the night, full of hope.
She vaguely felt that those few people were familiar. When she thought about it carefully, weren't they the disciples who she had done the mission with in the original master's memory and ended up breaking up on bad terms?
They are not direct disciples of the sect master, but ordinary disciples.
After they parted ways with Shu Mingzhao, the second senior brother told them a few tasks and asked them to do it themselves before disappearing.
After finally completing the task, the second senior brother has not come back yet.
Thinking that the other party might have gone to find Shu Zhaozhao, they did not wait where they were, but returned to where they were separated from Shu Zhaozhao.
Practitioners have better eyesight than ordinary people, and as expected, they can see two entangled people from a distance.
Who are the missing second senior brother and Shu Mingzhao?
Damn it, I can hear the applause from so far away. What is Shu Mizhao doing? !
They originally hated Shu Minzhao, but at this moment, their anger suddenly rose up in their hearts, and they rushed towards him with great vigor and arrogance. They were all very irritating and would scold anyone who went up to him.
Unexpectedly, upon closer inspection, Shu Minzhao's fair little face was stained with tears, and the ends of his eyes were red. He bit his slightly swollen lower lip and begged for help pitifully, "Second Senior Brother has been penetrated by demonic energy."
Quick, help!
The curse words were originally suppressed in his mouth. According to his seniority, Shu Mingzhao was his direct disciple, so they should call him Junior Sister.
But they didn't like Shu Mingzhao's style at all.
Always named.
